scenario.name: ramp-cpu-ort-b4-nospin
scenario.description: Task 5.5, one variable changed from ramp-cpu-ort-b4 (+ ramp-cpu-ort-b4-ext): ONNX Runtime's intra-op threads sleep when idle instead of busy-waiting (detector.spin false). With spinning the worker occupies ~9.2 cores even at 1 camera; a model-only check at 5 images/s gave 9.1 cores spinning vs 1.3 not, with equal saturated throughput but batch-1 latency 19 vs 43 ms. This measures the end-to-end effect: worker cores below saturation, freshness, and the ceiling. Same stack and worker otherwise (yolo11n, ONNX Runtime FP32, infer_batch 4, data-mini at 5 FPS per camera, 1280x720 q85), steps of 1, 3, 5, 6 and 7 cameras, warmup 20 s, hold 90 s, 3 repetitions, no query load. Start the worker with WORKER_BACKEND=onnxruntime WORKER_INFER_BATCH=4 WORKER_SPIN=false. Quiet host.
